title: Part D Prescription Drug Cost Share Carried Inside the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans
content:
Five of the six Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plans carry Part D prescription drug coverage inside the medical plan; the figures below are the drug cost-share figures of the plan held.

| Plan | Part D coverage carried in the plan | Part D deductible for the plan year (USD) | Total drug spend at which the initial coverage stage ends (USD) | Member out-of-pocket drug spend at which catastrophic coverage begins (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | yes | 615 | 5030 | 2100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | yes | 490 | 5030 | 2100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | yes | 250 | 5030 | 2100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | yes | 615 | 5030 | 2100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | yes | 0 | 5030 | 2100 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | no | 0 | 5030 | 2100 |

| Plan | 30-day preferred generic fill at a preferred retail pharmacy (USD) | 30-day preferred brand fill at a preferred retail pharmacy (USD) | 30-day specialty tier fill (per cent of the negotiated price) | Maximum member copay for a one-month supply of a covered insulin product (USD) | Multiplier applied to the 30-day retail cost share for a 90-day mail-order fill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 4 | 47 | 33 | 35 | 2.5 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 2 | 42 | 30 | 35 | 2.5 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 0 | 38 | 28 | 35 | 2.0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 4 | 47 | 33 | 35 | 2.5 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 0 | 35 | 25 | 35 | 2.0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 35 | 2.0 |

The insulin figure of 35 USD for a one-month supply is the same on every plan. The initial coverage limit of 5030 USD of total drug spend and the catastrophic threshold of 2100 USD of member out-of-pocket drug spend are likewise the same on every plan. Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) is the one plan that carries no Part D coverage inside it.
